author: Kairos I
title: Erudite v42 v1.5: ks_beta bootstrap + multi-specimen table
abstract: Runs KS_beta bootstrap (B=1000, parametric) and produces a multi-specimen CSV/JSON (single-specimen demo) for key metrics.

original_submission.content:
import sys, subprocess, shlex
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

SPEC = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v42_specimen.json'

def main():
    rc1 = subprocess.call(shlex.split(f"python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/run_ks_beta_bootstrap.py {SPEC} 1000 0 1"))
    print("RUN_KS_BETA_BOOTSTRAP_RC", rc1)
    rc2 = subprocess.call(shlex.split(f"python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/run_multi_specimen_v1_5.py {SPEC}"))
    print("RUN_MULTI_SPECIMEN_RC", rc2)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
